project.title: 454 pyrosequencing 16S rRNA data from two tannery wastewater treatment plant
project.description: For full understanding of the microbial community in the tannery wastewater treatment bioreactors, high-throughput 454-pyrosequencing of the 16S rRNA genes were conducted to investigate microbial community structure.
